headline: Fonterra Raises Farmgate Milk Price Forecast to $10.10/kg on Chinese Demand
summary: New Zealand dairy giant Fonterra upgraded its forecast farmgate milk price to $10.10 per kilogram of milk solids, citing strong import demand from China, while noting foreign exchange volatility.
why: Fonterra is the world's largest dairy exporter; its milk payout is the single biggest driver of New Zealand's agricultural sector income.

impacts.name: Fonterra Co-operative Group
impacts.why: Higher forecast milk prices improve farmer shareholder earnings and payout projections.
